Table 2. Percent of deaths of local jail inmates, by cause of death, 2000 and 2008–2018
Note: Data may have been revised from previously published statistics. Details may not sum to totals due to rounding. See Methodology.
a/In 2008, a high number of illness cases were missing cause-of-death information and were classified as missing.
b/Includes persons who died of illness and were identified as HIV-positive or having AIDS at the time of death.
c/Includes other specified illnesses (such as cerebrovascular disease, influenza, and other non-leading natural causes of death) and unspecified illnesses.
d/Includes homicides committed by other inmates, incidental to the use of force by staff, or resulting from assaults sustained prior to incarceration.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Mortality in Correctional Institutions, 2000 and 2008–2018.
